description: Answers several questions about one report at once, e.g. "What are Nvidia's risks, and what does management say about results?". Returns 2 or 3 sections of the same 10-K or 10-Q from SEC EDGAR as clean text, in one call: Risk Factors, MD&A, Business, Legal Proceedings, Market Risk, Cybersecurity. Same inputs and output per section as sec_filing_section (latest filing, a `fiscal_year` since 2001, or an exact `accession_number`; by ticker, CIK or company name), at $0.015 for up to three sections instead of $0.01 each. Sections the filing does not contain are listed in `not_found`; if none can be read you get 404, free. You are only charged when a result is returned: invalid input (400) and upstream failures (4xx/5xx) are not settled. Costs $0.015 USDC per call via x402. Paid per call with x402 inside MCP (see the server instructions).

accession_number.description: Return the section from this exact 10-K or 10-Q filing of the company, e.g. 0000320193-22-000108.

cik.description: SEC Central Index Key, e.g. 320193. Use this, `ticker` or `company`.

company.description: Company name, e.g. "Apple" or "Coca-Cola". Use this, `ticker` or `cik`; a name matching several companies returns their tickers, free.

fiscal_year.description: Return the report whose fiscal period ends in this calendar year instead of the latest one, e.g. 2022 for Apple's 10-K for the year ended September 24, 2022. For a 10-Q, the latest quarter ending in that year. EDGAR has HTML filings from 2001 on.

form.description: Annual report (10-K, the default) or quarterly report (10-Q). With `accession_number`, taken from that filing.

sections.description: 2 or 3 sections to read from the same filing: risk_factors, mda, business, legal_proceedings, market_risk, cybersecurity. Business and cybersecurity exist only in 10-Ks.

ticker.description: US stock ticker, e.g. AAPL, MSFT, BRK-B. Use this, `cik` or `company`.

via.description: Optional: the tool whose next_calls suggested this call (filled in for you).

name: sec_filing_sections
title: SEC 10-K / 10-Q sections, several at once
